unique_m96_direction.name: M96_FIXED_GROUP_REVERSIBLE_BANK_SKEW_WEIGHT_PACKING_PROBE
unique_m96_direction.objective: Reduce finite-bank source cycles by changing only the compile-time placement of the 256 source weights across the same eight banks.
frozen_components: M89 K6 parent choices and canonical DAG
K6 group membership and exact union masks
eight single-read banks, 96 lanes, weight bytes, DMA bytes and capacity
unique_m96_direction.selection: Choose one two-bit mode per operator over all ten samples; forbid per-group and per-sample adaptation.

storage_and_ports.address_logic: four small 3-bit bank mappings, with the winning mode later simplified or hardwired

unique_m96_direction.simulator_plan: Add an observation hook that seals ordered M89 union masks, compute exact baseline max-bank cycles and per-group ceil(popcount/8), then replay H0-H3 without changing group membership. Feed the resulting source completion times through the existing M45/M53 calendars.
unique_m96_direction.claim_boundary: Preimplementation transaction-model screen only. No RTL, equal-area, PPA, energy, full-network or system claim.
